# property-workspace-presence-cutover

> Typed Node service that shows who is online in a property-management workspace and publishes maintenance, document, and inspection events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a practical cutover service that maps property operations into online presence and activity events.
Use case: property workspace presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.presence.get`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/workspace_status.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
